name: United Arab Emirates
summary: Two MNOs, e& (Etisalat) and du (EITC). TDRA assigns spectrum administratively and publishes no auctions or per-operator register. Only the bands each operator uses are listed here. Only 3.5 GHz and 26 GHz could be attributed per operator.

operators.name: e&
operators.legal: Emirates Telecommunications Group Company PJSC (e& UAE)
operators.notes: Rebranded from Etisalat in 2022. Its reports describe a live 5G mmWave deployment (2023) and 6 GHz trials (2022–23).

bands.label: 600 MHz
bands.note: No IMT assignment identified. 470–694 MHz is used for broadcasting in Region 1.

bands.label: 700 MHz FDD
bands.note: Whether 700 MHz has been assigned to e& and/or du is not verified. TDRA assigns spectrum administratively and does not publish per-operator holdings in the sources reached. No per-operator amounts could be verified.

bands.label: 800 MHz FDD
bands.note: du uses B20 (Wikipedia LTE list: CA_3A_20A); e& also lists B20 in its carrier aggregation combinations. TDRA assigns spectrum administratively and does not publish per-operator holdings in the sources reached. No per-operator amounts could be verified.

bands.label: 850 MHz
bands.note: No IMT assignment identified (Region 1 band plan).

bands.label: 900 MHz
bands.note: GSM/UMTS 900 used by both operators. TDRA assigns spectrum administratively and does not publish per-operator holdings in the sources reached. No per-operator amounts could be verified.

bands.label: 1800 MHz
bands.note: LTE B3 used by both operators (Wikipedia LTE list). TDRA assigns spectrum administratively and does not publish per-operator holdings in the sources reached. No per-operator amounts could be verified.

bands.label: 1900–1920 MHz TDD
bands.note: TDRA assigns spectrum administratively and does not publish per-operator holdings in the sources reached. No per-operator amounts could be verified.

bands.label: 2100 MHz
bands.note: UMTS/LTE used by both operators. TDRA assigns spectrum administratively and does not publish per-operator holdings in the sources reached. No per-operator amounts could be verified.

bands.label: 2300 MHz TDD
bands.note: du uses B40 (Wikipedia LTE list, 20 MHz carrier). TDRA assigns spectrum administratively and does not publish per-operator holdings in the sources reached. No per-operator amounts could be verified.

bands.label: 2600 MHz
bands.note: e& uses B7 (Wikipedia LTE list). TDRA assigns spectrum administratively and does not publish per-operator holdings in the sources reached. No per-operator amounts could be verified.

bands.label: 3.3–3.8 GHz
bands.note: Per the CMS Expert Guide to 5G regulation (UAE): e& 3300–3600 MHz, du 3600–3800 MHz. Single non-regulator source; TDRA does not publish assignments.

bands.label: 6 GHz
bands.note: e& ran the 'first trial of the 6GHz spectrum in UAE' (2022) and reached 10 Gbps on 6 GHz (2023). No licensed assignment verified.

bands.label: 24–29 GHz mmWave
bands.note: TRA/TDRA assigned 1 GHz per operator in 25.5–27.5 GHz from Q3 2021 (Gulf News, Sep 2020; CMS guide). Exact positions not published.

notes: No per-operator spectrum amounts or positions could be sourced. TDRA's website, e& integrated reports 2019–2025 and du's investor pages (unreachable) were checked. Band entries show only which bands are in use, where a source says so.
The LTE band usage comes from Wikipedia's 'List of LTE networks in Asia', which is dated (2012–2016 launches).

Corrected after independent verification (2026-09-28): 3.5 GHz and 26 GHz filled in from the verifier's sources (CMS law guide; Gulf News quoting the regulator). The CMS guide also gives n41: du 2496–2596, e& 2596–2690 MHz (not drawn; single source).
